items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: And there was a very famous musician, more of a serious musician, Mary Lucinda Cauldwell who was responsible for a lot of the young musicians getting their early education in Pittsburgh.

ctx.x: And he lived by Montreal for some years.

Yes, I know. Quite talented family. And there was a very famous musician, more of a serious musician, Mary Lucinda Cauldwell who was responsible for a lot of the young musicians getting their early education in Pittsburgh. I suppose the musicians said, why come to New York? Pittsburgh was big enough for them and to become a member of an orchestra in Pittsburgh was no small thing. It's just like any other town, Cleveland, Ohio, and Chicago, Detroit, they all have their local bands, good bands.
Yes, although Chicago has been a place where musicians have migrated to.
